summary: Module 07 BUILD: Implemented asynchronous click logging and owner-scoped analytics retrieval. Configured Celery with Redis for background tasks. Under decision B (async queue), redirects return a 302 immediately and enqueue a click job via record_click.delay(). Added graceful degradation: if Redis is down, redirects still function, and click data drops safely. Ensured job idempotency via unique event_key on click_events table and SHA256 hashed IP for privacy. Created owner-scoped, rate-limited analytics retrieval route GET /links/<id>/analytics and a background retention purge task.
evidence: Integrated Celery app in app.worker and record_click/purge_old_clicks tasks in app.services.analytics
On redirect, _enqueue_click enqueues click recording asynchronously with a UUID event_key and SHA-256 client IP hash
Graceful degradation: redirect route catches Celery exception, logging a warning and proceeding with redirect
Protected GET /links/{link_id}/analytics checks link ownership and aggregates count and last clicked timestamp
All 38 test suite cases passing successfully
